name: Wand Channeler
body:
Prerequisites: Casts arcane or divine spells and can use spell trigger items without the Use Magic Device skill.

Benefit: You can sacrifice an unused spell slot to power the energies of a wand without expending a charge. The wand must contain a spell that you could normally cast based on your class and of a level you have access and have at least one charge. This feat expends a daily spell slot for the spell level of the spell generated by the wand. Higher level spell slots may be expended as desired. This ability does not alter the effective caster level of the wand.
